Dream Catcher: The soul will receive half a soul heart for every new floor he follows Isaac to, allowing him to survive multiple hits and gather up to a maximum of 12 soul hearts. His health resets when the trinket is dropped.
Dull Razor: Allows the soul to activate items that would otherwise be useless, such as Old Bandage, Fanny Pack, Varicose Veins etc. It can also be used to dodge damage.

Empty Heart: The soul will receive an empty heart container every floor; however, the soul cannot collect any Red Hearts, but can receive them via Yum Heart's multiplayer healing or if Isaac collects one while at full red hearts.
Everything Jar: Regardless of current charges, the soul will always pay out with a poop on every use of the jar.
Eye of Greed: Coin tears fired still subtract coins.
Gnawed Leaf: Invincibility is independent of Isaac's movement.
Guillotine: No head orbital is granted to the soul. Other stats still apply.
Glowing Hourglass: The soul's health will be reset (so it will die in one hit even if it obtained some health before the rewind.) It will also be revived if it died in the previous room.

Hollow Heart: The soul receives a bone heart at the start of a floor, but only if alive when entering the floor.
IBS: The soul itself can never trigger IBS, however when Isaac receives a poop, so does the soul.
Isaac's Heart: The soul becomes immortal and can not be killed. It will also deal contact damage equal to 4x its damage stat.
Jar of Wisps: The soul will spawn a single random wisp each time, and the amount spawned do not increment with each use.
Lemegeton: The soul will get its own Lemegeton wisps orbiting it, but none of them give their respective item effect.
Lemegeton + Book of Virtues: Wisps spawned by the soul while Isaac has Book of Virtues will be buffed.
Maggy's Faith: The soul will receive an Eternal Heart for every new floor he follows Isaac to. The Eternal Heart will become a heart container if the soul goes to the next floor with it.
Magic Fingers: The damage is only applied from the soul's part, meaning this item will always deal less damage while the soul is carried around.
Montezuma's Revenge / Revelation: The beam's damage is not halved for the soul.
Mom's Bracelet: The soul can indeed pick up rocks and throw them, despite lacking sprite work.
Notched Axe: The soul can swing the axe once, then breaks permanently, unable to be recharged.
Picking Notched Axe from a pedestal by swapping with another active item or by dropping it with Butter! will refresh the Found Soul single use Notched Axe, allowing for infinite used on the floor.
Red Key: With proper placement, the soul can open another red room, for free.

Redemption: The soul will receive a cross when a Devil Room is entered, and will not lose it when Isaac takes an item/pickup. When Isaac goes to a new floor with the familiar having the cross, the soul will receive a damage boost (even if Isaac doesn't) and a Soul Heart, allowing it to survive multiple hits.
Scissors: The soul will spew its own blood fountain, but no extra head will spawn.
The Scooper: An extra Peeper familiar is not spawned; however, the soul will benefit from the right eye damage boost.
Sharp Key: The soul will throw its own key in tandem with Isaac. The throw still costs one key.
Status Effects: Damage is not halved for the soul.
Spirit Shackles: The soul will be chained next to the spot it got hit. Proceeding to not get hit again for a short time will revive the soul as normal.
Super Magnet: The soul will have its own attraction field. No effect on pickups.
Toxic Shock: No effect.
Tractor Beam: The soul does not receive a beam, nor are any of its tears affected by Isaac's beam.
Void / Black Rune: Stat changes from them do not affect the soul.
Whore of Babylon: Will always be active on the soul.
Wooden Cross: Both Isaac and the soul will receive a temporary shield; however, when one of them loses it, so does the other.

name: Expansion Pack
description: Once per room, using an active item triggers another random active item effect.
effects: Upon use of an activated item, activates the effect of another random activated item.
The random effect is any activated item with a charge time of 1 or 2 rooms (with the exception of Metronome, D infinity, and Esau Jr..) View the page on activated items for a complete list.
Timed-recharge and infinite-use items trigger the effect once per room. Re-entering the room will allow Expansion Pack to trigger again.

synergies.text: / Mom's Box: Having either activates the effect of another random 1 or 2 charge active item. Having both activates 2 another random 1 or 2 charge and 1 random 3 charge active item.

name: Beth's Essence
description: Upon entering an Angel Room, spawns 5 wisp orbitals. Giving money to Beggars can spawn wisps.
effects: Upon entering an Angel Room, spawns 5 normal blue wisp orbitals.
Also applies to The Stairway's shop.
Donating to any kind of Beggar has a chance to create a random wisp orbital.

synergies.text: / Mom's Box: The wisps have a 50% chance to be special wisps. Having both increases the chance to 100%.

name: The Twins
description: Adds a chance to duplicate one of Isaac's familiars when entering a new room.
effects: Adds a 50% chance to duplicate one of Isaac's familiars when entering a new room.
If Isaac has no familiars, spawns Brother Bobby or Sister Maggy instead.

synergies.text: / Mom's Box / The Twins: Each copy grants an additional 50% chance to trigger the effect again. This results in another familiar doubling. This can be the same familiar that was doubled originally. The duplication chance of three or more stacks can go above 100% allowing for even more duplicate familiars or Brother Bobbys/Sister Maggys to be created.

Sacrificial Altar: Both the duplicated familiar (if one is available) and Brother Bobby/Sister Maggy (if not available) can be sacrificed for an item reward. This does not remove the trinket, and fully retains its effect.

interactions.text: Movement-mimicking familiars: Duplicated familiars will follow the original on the same delay.
In the case of Shade, a copy of the familiar will spawn even if Shade was already absorbed by Isaac.

Pickup-generating familiars: If they remain duplicated for enough consecutive rooms, they will give a pickup as normal. The following familiars have to be duplicated for the following number of consecutive room clears to give pickups
Sack of Pennies: 1 room (will give a coin every time it’s duplicated)
Bomb Bag / Little C.H.A.D.: 2 rooms
Mystery Sack / Rune Bag / Sack of Sacks: 5 rooms
Acid Baby: 6 rooms
The Relic: 7 rooms
Because Lil Chest and Charged Baby’s chances to spawn pickups are independent from the total number of rooms cleared with them, they have an extra chance to pay out in any room they’re duplicated in.
No longer attempts to duplicate 1up!.
Bum Friend / Bumbo / Dark Bum / Key Bum / Lil Portal: The pickup count of duplicated familiars is not remembered when they go away.
Ball of Bandages / Cube of Meat: Upgrades the familiar instead of duplicating it.
Best Bud / Bird Cage: If the trinket tries to duplicate it, it will instead immediately activate. Taking damage does not spawn another familiar.
If this happens to Bird Cage as Isaac walks into a room with enemies, Bird Cage will also leap onto the enemies.
Blood Puppy / Bumbo / Guppy's Hairball: The duplicate will always be at its first stage.
Buddy in a Box: The duplicated familiar will be randomly generated instead of copying the original.
Cambion Conception / Immaculate Conception: Familiars given by these items can be duplicated as normal.
GB Bug: The familiar can be duplicated even if it hasn’t respawned; by constantly moving to new rooms, GB Bug can constantly respawn, allowing pickups to be rerolled indefinitely.
Guillotine: The head can be duplicated, and will give an extra damage and tears up if it is. The extra head will be unable to fire tears.
Hallowed Ground: Duplicate poops will also drop when Isaac takes damage. The bonuses from standing in the aura of multiple white poops does not stack.
The trinket will not attempt to duplicate these familiars, and will correctly spawn the default Brother Bobby/Sister Maggy if Isaac does not have other familiars.
Mystery Egg: The friendly the duplicated egg spawns depends on how many consecutive rooms cleared the duplicate persisted for.
Succubus: The damage multiplier from standing in the aura of multiple Succubi multiplicatively stacks.
YO LISTEN!: An extra +1 luck will be given for every duplicate.

name: Adoption Papers
description: Shops can sell familiars, which will always be at a discounted price.
effects: Shops and Black Markets now sell familiars instead of the usual item selection.
The familiars are chosen from the Baby Shop item pool.
While holding the Adoption Papers, the familiars are discounted to 10 coins. If the papers are dropped, they cost 15 coins.

synergies.text: / Mom's Box: Familiars are always on sale. Shops will also be able to sell Soul of Lilith if isaac has both and Mom's Box.
Steam Sale: Both of the discounts stack, selling familiars for 5 cents.

interactions.text: Chaos: Chaos takes priority in item selection. However, items will still be discounted.
Eden's Soul / Mystery Gift: Ignores the effect of Adoption Papers, spawning items from the Shop pool if used there.
Flip: The ghostly items will be from the Shop pool.
Glitched Crown: While one of the items will come from the Baby Shop pool, the other 4 items cycled between will come from the regular Shop pool, all of which still discounted at 10 coins.
Keeper's Box: Does not affect Keeper's Box' items, meaning both familiars and shop items can be purchased in tandem over the course of a run.
Member Card / The Stairway: The extra shops are unaffected by Adoption Papers.

name: Cricket Leg
description: Adds a 1/6 chance to spawn a random locust when killing an enemy.
effects: Has a 1/6 chance to spawn a random locust when killing an enemy.
Up to 4 White Locusts can be spawned from a single enemy.
The trinket is not affected by luck.

synergies.text: / Mom's Box/ Cricket Leg: The chance to spawn a locust increases to 1/3.
Multiple copies of the trinket increase the chance by 1/6 per copy. At 6 copies, enemies are guaranteed to spawn locusts on death.
Bomber Boy: Red locusts explode in a small horizontal cross-shape pattern.
Brimstone Bombs: Red locusts will shoot out four brimstone beams in a + formation after hitting an enemy.
Glitter Bombs: Red locust explosions have a chance to spawn pickups or trinkets.
Hive Mind: Increases locusts' size and doubles their damage.
Red locusts’ impact damage is doubled and the explosion damage is increased to 85.
Sad Bombs: Red locusts fire a ring of ten tears outward upon detonation, which are affected by Isaac's tear modifiers, and deal damage equal to 15 + 0.6x, where x is Isaac's Damage.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups don’t spawn locusts.
E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop don't spawn locusts.

name: Apollyon's Best Friend
description: Spawns an Abyss locust familiar which will fly forward while Isaac shoots.
effects: Spawns an attack locust familiar identical to the default ones spawned by Abyss. It will fly forward while Isaac is shooting and deals contact damage equal to Isaac's damage.
The locust is treated as a Quality 3 locust and deals 1.5x Isaac's damage.

synergies.text: Apollyon's Best Friend / / Mom's Box: Each effect/trinket copy stacks, granting an extra locust per stack.
BFFS! / Hive Mind: Increases the locust's damage by 25%.

needsReview: The locust is treated as a Quality 3 locust and deals 1.5x Isaac's damage.

name: Broken Glasses
description: Gives a 50% chance to add a '?' item to Treasure Rooms. Only one item can be taken. The extra items on the alt path are revealed instead.
effects: 50% chance of adding an extra blind item in Treasure Rooms.
When one of the items is taken, the other disappears.
The extra blind items in Downpour, Dross, Mines, Ashpit, Mausoleum, and Gehenna (and Corpse if Bloody Crown is held) have a 50% chance to be revealed instead.

synergies.text: / Mom's Box: The chance to add a blind item in Treasure rooms is now 100%. The chance to reveal the blind item in the alt path Treasure rooms is now 100%.
Damocles: An additional visible item will be generated from the blind item.
Devil's Crown: Both items can be taken, but still need to be paid for, and one will remain blind if not on the alt path.

interactions.text: Golden Horse Shoe: The second item will always be blind if not on the alt path.
This doesn't apply to More Options.

name: Ice Cube
description: Adds a chance to petrify enemies when entering the room. Killing the petrified enemy freezes it.
effects: Upon entering a room, each enemy has a 20% chance to be petrified for 4 seconds. Enemies that have been petrified by Ice Cube are frozen when killed, including those killed up to 2 seconds after the petrifaction effect ends.
The chance for enemies to be petrified increases with luck, reaching 100% at 40 Luck.

synergies.text: / Mom's Box: Having either increase the base chance to petrify enemies upon entering a room to 33%. Having both increase the base chance to 50%.
Second Hand: Extends the time period that allows for enemies to be frozen after the petrifaction effect ends from 2 to 6 seconds.

name: Sigil of Baphomet
description: Grants an invulnerability shield for 1 second after killing an enemy.
effects: Shields Isaac for 1 second after killing an enemy.
If another enemy is killed while Isaac is shielded, another second is added to the shield's duration.
Up to 5 seconds of invincibility can be accumulated.

synergies.text: / Mom's Box: Having either increase the shield duration to 1.5 second and 7.5 seconds of invincibility can be accumulated. Having both increase the shield duration to 2 seconds and 10 seconds of invincibility can be accumulated.
Kamikaze!: Isaac can chain-kill enemies without taking explosion damage while the shield is active.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups don’t activate the shield or extend its duration.
E. Coli / Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop don’t activate the shield or extend its duration.
Freeze Effects: Enemies that are frozen don't activate the shield or extend its duration.

Because of this interaction, when Isaac has Uranus, only enemies killed by icicles from statues, bombs, familiars and other sources will activate Sigil of Baphomet's effects, thus rendering the trinket quite difficult to use.
Frozen enemies do activate the shield and can extend its duration.
Friendly Enemies: When friendly enemies spawned by items die, they activate the shield or extend its duration.

name: Tonsil
description: Grants a familiar that follows Isaac and blocks enemy shots.
effects: After taking 12-20 / 6-12 hits a removed tonsil familiar starts following Isaac, blocking enemy shots.
The effect can happen twice, after which the trinket will be destroyed.
The familiar does not deal damage to enemies.

synergies.text: / Mom's Box: Having either can generate a 3rd tonsil before destroying the trinket. Having both can generate a 4th tonsil before destroying it.
